comment: Every Math.random() in supabase/functions/, named with its purpose. check-fabricated-data.mjs strips comments, counts calls per file, and fails on any file or count not covered here — counts may only fall. A random number is legitimate as jitter, an id, or a rendering handle; it is fabrication the moment it lands in a figure a report can carry. Adding an entry is a reviewed act and the purpose field is the review.

supabase/functions/_shared/ghl-rate-limi.purpose: Retry backoff jitter (0.75x-1.25x of the base delay). Never a figure.

supabase/functions/generate-investment-r.purpose: Retry jitter on the section loop (0-1000ms, 0-500ms). Never a figure.

supabase/functions/render-investment-rep.purpose: SVG gradient element ids (sg-/lg- handles). Rendering identity, not data.

supabase/functions/report-qa/index.ts.purpose: Stream id fallback when crypto.randomUUID is absent. An identifier, not a figure.

supabase/functions/ai-dashboard-agent/in.purpose: Tool-call id fallback (call_<random>). An identifier, not a figure.

supabase/functions/manage-ci-assessments.purpose: Assessment reference-code suffix. An identifier, not a figure.

supabase/functions/admin-user-management.purpose: Temporary password generation. Not report data — but flagged: Math.random() is not a CSPRNG, and a credential drawn from it deserves crypto.getRandomValues(). Tracked as a hardening follow-up; this entry may not grow.
